approval_source.question_set: E05-d: builder scope, issuance controller calibration, fee values and the transfer range rule

decisions.question: E05-d scope
decisions.rule: Build the deterministic genesis builder against the profiles the node accepts today. Open values come from a labeled proposals file and the manifest marks the output not production. A committed synthetic build is rebuilt byte for byte and loaded by the Rust node and the Go engine; check_bindings is extended to the full configuration. Production activation (the development gates and the chain-ID ban) is its own design step.

decisions.question: D01-Q01
decisions.note: Issuance stays at 1,000 DRT a block up to 50% utilization, then falls linearly to 500 at full blocks, one epoch later. Soft and hard gains are equal, so the shock threshold and integral bounds have no effect; they stay open as proposals. If the capacity tests (T05) show blocks cannot fill completely, the proportional gain is rescaled so the floor is reached at the measured maximum.

decisions.question: D04-Q01
decisions.note: Gas price 10 times minimum gas 100,000 is 1 DRT. A basic ML-DSA-65 Send uses about 47,600 gas, so it pays the floor; the governed gas price range 1 to 100 moves it between 0.1 and 10 DRT.

decisions.question: D10-Q02
decisions.selected: Floor pricing, free reads (recovery on the same scale)
decisions.note: Each sponsored recovery action costs the sponsor at least 1 DRT.

decisions.question: D11-Q03
decisions.rule: A fee-profile governance proposal is refused unless a reference basic Send, at fixed sizes, would cost between 0.1 and 10 DRT under the proposed values. Built with production activation, with tests.
